name: Special Order
source:
'Special Order' is a short visual novel, where you make an order in a femboy themed fast-food chain. The one boy in particular is your favourite. Do you think you will meet him today?

[From [url=https://bun-tired.itch.io/special-order]itch.io[/url]]
